label: Telegram (bot)

params.text: Allkin is properly connected to this conversation.

pinnedParam.name: chat_id
pinnedParam.label: Identifier of the conversation (chat_id)
pinnedParam.hint: The bot will only be able to write to this conversation, whatever an agent asks. To get it: write a message to the bot, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<YOUR_TOKEN>/getUpdates and note chat.id (negative for a group).

agentGuide: One thing to know: POST /sendMessage with a JSON body {"text": "…"}. Do not add chat_id — the destination is set by the user and rewritten before sending, whatever you put would be ignored. The text accepts HTML with parse_mode: "HTML" (<b>, <i>, <code>, <a href>) — not the full markdown. GET /getMe checks the connection. You only send: Allkin receives no message.
